# Methods Tracking Document

1)  created sample event list (creating_sample_event_list.Rmd)

2)  data-rounds-analysis.rmd

    -   assigned julian date to each survey based on calendar date using yday() function in lubridate R package

    -   plotted field type vs julian date for each type of data (bee, veg, rodent) to check for systematic differences in timing among the two field types

        -   overall and grouped by site pair

3)  rodent-burrow-analysis.rmd

-   plotted number of each species ID (dm, v, unknown, other) in each field type

-   filtered to only burrows with certain species IDs

    -   plotted hole id vs diameter size

    -   plotted number of burrows of each species in each field type

-   filtered to only burrows with certain activity IDs (active or inactive)

    -   plotted active vs inactive in each field type
